title: Hurt
lyrics:
[00:00.56]My day will come, I gave too much
[00:05.83]I sold my soul, I'm waiting for
[00:10.80]My pay in full, I only want
[00:15.84]Your dying love, I've seen enough
[00:21.09]I tried, but I don't think so
[00:26.03]Maybe it was me who was fuckin' up
[00:31.18]I gave all I could give, but
[00:36.65]It seems like it never really was enough
[00:40.87]I feel left out, I don't see how
[00:43.36]My whole life can change in one week
[00:45.81]I don't mind my own reflection
[00:48.44]I don't see how you've been let down
[00:51.28]Don't speak unless you have to
[00:53.50]Why you always seem in a bad mood?
[00:56.32]Your whole life, you had an attitude
[00:58.98]One day, is that so bad for you?
[01:01.50]I'm sorry if I hurt you
[01:04.20]I'm sorry if it got that bad
[01:06.77]I'm sorry I can't help you
[01:09.29]Somebody shoulda had your back
[01:12.00]I tried, but I don't think so
[01:17.14]Maybe it was me who was fuckin' up
[01:22.25]I gave all I could give, but
[01:27.69]It seems like it never really was enough
[01:32.22]I changed my whole life when
[01:34.75]I learned to ignore them
[01:37.33]I changed my whole life up
[01:39.83]Maybe it was not enough
[01:42.42]I don't think I'm allowed to
[01:44.84]Make a deal with your selfish ways
[01:47.49]They're acting vicious out there
[01:50.04]There's lots of demons out here
[01:52.71]I'm sorry if I hurt you
[01:55.28]I'm sorry if it got that bad
[01:57.90]I'm sorry I can't help you
[02:00.31]Somebody shoulda had your back
[02:03.16]I tried, but I don't think so
[02:08.26]Maybe it was me who was fuckin' up
[02:13.32]I gave all I could give, but
[02:18.75]It seems like it never really was enough
